tasks.spec:
You are an implementation worker on freytag-forge. Working directory: the real repository /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (no worktree). Use .venv/bin/python with PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge and TMPDIR=/tmp; never use uv. NO billed or network calls, no credentials, no .env.

HARD RULES. You own ONLY scripts/ringer/stage7/door_prompt.py, door_probe.py, check_door_probe.py, test_door_probe.py. Touch nothing else (untracked .plans files and bench/results are intentionally present; leave them). No git add/commit/reset/clean/checkout/stash/push. Do NOT edit data/stories/*, bench/frozen/*, bench/variations/*, storygame/*. The door, source and completion experiments must stay byte-for-byte reproducible and every existing test must pass unchanged.

BACKGROUND. The Stage 7 'grounded' experiment (already built, commit cf9960b5; read all four files first) compares control = frozen pre-panel package bench/frozen/continuity-pre-2a-panel against grounded = current package data/stories/continuity-initiative, by patching the recorded 2A turn-7 prompt. Today door_prompt.py hardcodes the four added CONSTRAINTS lines (GROUNDED_LINES). The story text is being revised by the author, so the additions must be DERIVED from the packages, not hardcoded.

TASK (test-first).
1. Derive the additions. Build the shipped 2A prompt for both packages offline with the same code path as `python -m bench prompt --scene 2A --player-input <the recorded command> ` (bench.core.prompt_for with a variation dict; see bench/cli.py for how --package is turned into a variation; no model call). Compute, per section (SCENE, THINGS, CONSTRAINTS), the lines present in the current-package prompt but absent from the frozen-package prompt. Assert: no line is REMOVED in any section, and additions occur only in SCENE, THINGS or CONSTRAINTS. The grounded arm patches the recorded user string by appending each section's added lines to the end of that same section (preserving separators and every other byte; preserve line format '- text'). Fail loudly if the recorded section lacks a trailing blank-line separator or an added line is already present. If there are zero additions the grounded experiment must raise an error (nothing to test). Remove the hardcoded GROUNDED_LINES/GROUNDED_ANCHORS or keep them only as test expectations for the CURRENT package state (the test may assert the current derivation equals those four CONSTRAINTS lines, but mark that assertion clearly so it can be updated when the story changes).
2. THINGS fidelity. The recorded prompt lists only 'Kristin. Place: ...' in THINGS because the replay never ran the per-turn match call. Add a documented, deterministic emulation: drive the real ItemFactsProvider offline (see storygame/runtime/item_facts.py prepare_turn and _things_block; stub the network request so the match reply is {"refers": ["access panel"], "same_as": {}, "kind": {}}, then render the THINGS block the narrator would get for the recorded command in scene 2A with Kristin in the infrastructure corridors). If this can be done with a small stub and no edits outside the four owned files, ALSO record in the grounded prompt artifact (a new key 'things_emulation') the THINGS lines this yields for the current package, and for the frozen package; do NOT change the patched prompt with them (the screen keeps its fixed patch semantics) -- the emulation is reported evidence only. If the emulation cannot be done without editing other files, record that finding in the final message and skip it.
3. Grounded-route verdict fields. The reviewed-mode verdict schema for experiment 'grounded' gains three required booleans: declared_panel_used (the arm's narration or continuation used the declared cooling-service archive panel), invented_access_object (an access object/route not declared in the package appears: seam, keypad, screen, grille, a different panel, etc.), reached_archive_without_new_credential (the continuation reached the records archive investigation with no new credential prerequisite, lock or detention access). The checker must require them for grounded verdicts only (other experiments unchanged), and require reached_archive_without_new_credential to be consistent with earned_by_command_2 is NOT required (they are separate measures). Summary for grounded: per-arm counts of each field plus door_appears (declared_panel_used or invented_access_object true) per arm; decision rule: grounded 'wins' only if reached_archive_without_new_credential>=10/12 AND earned_by_command_2>=10/12 AND unsupported invention (invented_access_object)<=2/12 AND premature_disclosure==0 AND contradictory_delivery==0 AND earned exceeds control's earned by at least 3; N!=12 -> 'not_decided'. Never classify by keyword/regex.
4. Normal-exit guard test (offline, in test_door_probe.py): assert that between bench/frozen/continuity-pre-2a-panel and data/stories/continuity-initiative the files pacing.yaml, knowledge.yaml, handoffs.yaml, storylets.md and storylet-routes.yaml are byte-identical, and that the t_2a_2b transition's triggers and required_dependencies (load the current package and read them) do not mention cooling_service_archive_panel. Print a clear message on failure.
5. Other tests: derivation yields additions only in allowed sections and none removed (use synthetic prompts for the failure cases), zero-additions raises, patched grounded user equals control user plus exactly the derived lines, system identical across arms, dry run --experiment grounded passes check_door_probe.py, door/source/completion unchanged.

VERIFY before finishing: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest scripts/ringer/stage7/test_door_probe.py -q`; `.venv/bin/ruff format` and `.venv/bin/ruff check` on the four changed files; dry runs plus checker for grounded, completion, source and door. Final message: files changed, test counts, what the THINGS emulation showed (paste both THINGS blocks), deviations.
tasks.check: cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp && .venv/bin/python -m pytest scripts/ringer/stage7/test_door_probe.py -q > /tmp/g2.out 2>&1; tail -8 /tmp/g2.out; grep -q ' passed' /tmp/g2.out && ! grep -q ' failed\| error' /tmp/g2.out && .venv/bin/ruff check scripts/ringer/stage7/door_prompt.py scripts/ringer/stage7/door_probe.py scripts/ringer/stage7/check_door_probe.py scripts/ringer/stage7/test_door_probe.py && .venv/bin/ruff format --check scripts/ringer/stage7/door_prompt.py scripts/ringer/stage7/door_probe.py scripts/ringer/stage7/check_door_probe.py scripts/ringer/stage7/test_door_probe.py && for e in grounded completion source; do rm -rf /tmp/$e-dry2 && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/door_probe.py --n 1 --experiment $e --dry-run --out /tmp/$e-dry2 && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/check_door_probe.py /tmp/$e-dry2 1 --mode dry --experiment $e; done && rm -rf /tmp/door-dry2 && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/door_probe.py --n 1 --dry-run --out /tmp/door-dry2 && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/check_door_probe.py /tmp/door-dry2 1 --mode dry && test -z "$(git status --short -- storygame data bench/frozen bench/variations)"
tasks.verified: Tests pass, ruff clean, dry runs accepted, additions derived from packages, grounded verdict fields enforced, normal-exit guard test present, no story/runtime edits.
